Art-directed case study / Architecture & profiles

Designing clarity for a professional practice

Project intention

A studio profile that needs to introduce a practice without losing the quiet confidence of its work. The design moves from an architectural cover to a consistent interior language.

Design decisions

Restrained image use, deliberate scale changes, and a steady grid help the reader move between the practice, its thinking, and its work.
